title: Programmed cell death in primary Sjögren's disease: regulatory network analysis and therapeutic prospects evaluation.
snippet: Primary Sjögren's disease (SjD) is an autoimmune disorder characterized by chronic inflammation of exocrine glands, such as the salivary and lacrimal glands.
